title: Email to Nolan about a glowing object that drops molten metal

tellings.quote: Actually, there's one that I just got in the last few weeks an email from somebody who uh it's a a glowing object that drops molten metal.

plain: Someone wrote to the Stanford scientist Garry Nolan in 2021 to report a glowing object that dropped molten metal. Nolan, who studies material said to come from UFOs, tells Michels the email had arrived only a few weeks before. He mentions it as one more of the reports that reach him, the kind that would leave physical material behind to test if it were real.
